title: He Nailed His Family Inside A Basement . . .

segments.say: This dad let his neighbor *die* outside his door, and his own daughter watched him do it.

segments.text: If you go out there, I'll kill you.

segments.say: A *nuclear missile* was coming, so Jack ran his family into the basement and *nailed* the door shut.
Then the neighbor knocked. Her kids were *sick*. Jack refused to open.
Weeks later, the radio said the radiation had dropped. So they made *armor* and went up.
Then everything went *black*. Back down, Anna got a fever. And one night, she stopped *answering*.
Days later, she *opened* her eyes, and asked how long it had been. Jack *lied*.
The next morning, they opened the door to a *blinding* light.
Did Anna really wake up, or did they *lose their minds* down there? Comment what was outside.
